record.goal: A non-git KV ledger store reader for store_type GATEWAY_ENCRYPTED_BLOB, built over the KV gateway storage adapter (encrypted blobs addressed by ##_<name> location), so KV's own ledger and the SKAP Vault ledger inside KV are read back from user-owned storage behind a GATEWAY node with Lane B's per-endpoint ledger designation (org#162 issuecomment-6372170864) and the InTr verifier code reused unchanged. The reader decrypts and verifies content-addressed objects on KV's side only, requires a signed KV ledger head (kv_ledger_head_signer, TVC#542 pattern), refuses any head older than the newest Org-recorded KV head digest with six-field KV_LEDGER_HEAD_ROLLBACK_DETECTED, never takes an empty or missing ledger as a genesis, never admits the external storage's own records (metadata, revisions, sharing) as ledger input, and refuses an org designation for a KV or SKAP_VAULT endpoint.
